text: 法国兴业银行的利率策略师在一份报告中表示，鉴于不确定性可能持续，法国政府债券（OAT）市场的主导力量预计将从外国投资者转向国内投资者。策略师表示：“尽管利差仍倾向于扩大，但这种趋势存在一定限度：投资者可能会低配法国资产，但不太可能完全退出法国国债市场。”与此同时，进一步加息的讨论远未尘埃落定。持续存在的通胀风险提醒市场，如果价格压力再次显现，各国央行仍可能需要进一步收紧货币政策。
text_en: Societe Generale rate strategists said in a report that given the uncertainty may persist, the dominant force in the French government bond (OAT) market is expected to shift from foreign investors to domestic investors. The strategists said: "Although spreads still tend to widen, there is a limit to this trend: investors may underweight French assets, but are unlikely to completely exit the French government bond market." Meanwhile, discussion of further rate hikes is far from settled. Persistent inflation risks remind the market that if price pressures re-emerge, central banks may still need to tighten monetary policy further.
